thread:
zoe: Scanner flagged a high CVE in libssl inside our base image, needs rebuild + signed artifact before promote.
mike: Is that coming from the distro packages or something vendored into the image?
zoe: distro package. SBOM snippet: openssl 1.1.1k layer sha256:aa11bbcc...; runtime shows vulnerable symbol table.
tanya: Plan: rebuild base with patched openssl, produce fresh SBOM, and cosign using a short-lived KMS subkey. IAM binding should be time-limited and only grant AsymmetricSign to ci-rebuilder.
mike: Also ensure Cloud Audit Logs capture the AsymmetricSign call and push to the security sink. I'll add the log filter and alert.
ops-bot: [CI] rebuild-job-#77 queued by zoe 1 scanned layers, pending sign step.
zoe: Please create subkey name 'rebuild-libssl-4315' scoped to staging and bind for 1 hour; pipeline will stamp BUILD_ID and TRIGGERED_BY into image labels for traceability.
tanya: On it. I'll post the minimal IAM JSON + revoke procedure here when ready.
